versions.changelog:
- Clarified that DOCX and PDF files are saved locally by default, not uploaded or published automatically.
- Added a new "Scope & Permissions" section outlining local operation and the need for explicit user action to export or publish files.
- Removed references to automatic SharePoint upload and optional email/cloud export from feature descriptions and requirements.
- Emphasized that a final human review is required before publication or sharing.
- Updated formatting rules to reflect local file saving.

- Removed the file: agents/herbert/TOOLS.md
- Updated requirements: replaced specific SharePoint and Gmail APIs with general cloud storage and email integrations
- Documentation now reflects broader compatibility for document export and delivery integrations

Version 1.0.3 — No code or documentation changes detected.

- No new features, fixes, or content updates in this release.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged from the previous version.

- Updated skill title and description for greater clarity and conciseness.
- No functional or workflow changes; documentation only.

- Updated skill display name from "Atelier — Literary Writing Skill for OpenClaw" to "Atelier Littéraire — Literary Writing Skill for OpenClaw"
- No functional or workflow changes; all usage, agent structure, requirements, and formatting rules remain unchanged

Atelier 1.0.0 — initial release as a literary writing workflow for OpenClaw:

- Introduces two specialized subagents: Hermine (ideation) and Herbert (literary writing).
- End-to-end workflow: generating narrative axes from a pitch, running jury scoring, and producing high-quality literary documents.
- Produces final output in DOCX and PDF formats, formatted to strict editorial standards.
- Integration with SharePoint for automated document upload (optional).
- Requires Anthropic Claude API; SharePoint and Gmail integrations are optional.
